question: On the occasion of Republic Day 2025, the president of India conferred how many Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards-2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**49**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jeevan Raksha Padak Series of Awards** are prestigious awards given by the **Government of India** to recognize acts of courage and self-sacrifice in saving lives.
 
• These awards are conferred annually by the **President of India** on the occasion of **Republic Day**.
 
• The awards are categorized into three types: **Sarvottam Jeevan Raksha Padak**, **Uttam Jeevan Raksha Padak**, and **Jeevan Raksha Padak**.
 
• The awards are given to individuals who display outstanding bravery in saving lives under circumstances such as accidents, natural calamities, or other emergencies.
 
• In **2024**, a total of **49 awards** were conferred, showcasing the immense courage and selfless service of individuals across the country.
 
• The recipients of these awards include civilians and government officials who risk their lives to save others.
 
• These awards promote the spirit of heroism and inspire others to act courageously in times of danger.
